arguments.description: Read the log manifest to gather log file metadata

content.text:
Here is the extracted metadata for the 10 log files:

| Name             | Size (MB) | Last Modified | Rotations  |
|------------------|-----------|---------------|------------|
| application.log  | 245.3     | 2024-03-14    | 2          |
| access.log       | 512.7     | 2024-03-15    | 3          |
| error.log        | 78.2      | 2024-03-02    | 1          |
| debug.log        | 1024.0    | 2024-02-28    | 4          |
| audit.log        | 45.1      | 2024-03-14    | 0          |
| security.log     | 32.8      | 2024-03-10    | 1          |
| cron.log         | 8.5       | 2024-03-15    | 0          |
| mail.log         | 156.4     | 2024-03-01    | 5          |
| daemon.log       | 92.0      | 2024-03-05    | 2          |
| kern.log         | 203.6     | 2024-03-12    | 1          |

Let's determine which files to rotate (based on size >= 100 MB, or last_modified is older than 7 days compared to 2024-03-15), the age in days, action and reason, and estimate the space to free.

I'll now calculate for each file.
Let's evaluate each file:

### Rotation Criteria
- **Size threshold:** 100 MB
- **Age threshold:** Last modified before 2024-03-08 (older than 7 days from 2024-03-15)
- **Max rotations:** 5

### Calculations

| Name             | Size (MB) | Last Modified | Age (days) | Reason         | Action                   | Current Rotations |
|------------------|-----------|---------------|------------|---------------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| application.log  | 245.3     | 2024-03-14    | 1          | size          | rotate                   | 2                |
| access.log       | 512.7     | 2024-03-15    | 0          | size          | rotate                   | 3                |
| error.log        | 78.2      | 2024-03-02    | 13         | age           | rotate                   | 1                |
| debug.log        | 1024.0    | 2024-02-28    | 16         | both          | rotate                   | 4                |
| audit.log        | 45.1      | 2024-03-14    | 1          | within        | skip                     | 0                |
| security.log     | 32.8      | 2024-03-10    | 5          | within        | skip                     | 1                |
| cron.log         | 8.5       | 2024-03-15    | 0          | within        | skip                     | 0                |
| mail.log         | 156.4     | 2024-03-01    | 14         | both          | skip_max_reached         | 5                |
| daemon.log       | 92.0      | 2024-03-05    | 10         | age           | rotate                   | 2                |
| kern.log         | 203.6     | 2024-03-12    | 3          | size          | rotate                   | 1                |

- **To rotate:** application.log, access.log, error.log, debug.log, daemon.log, kern.log (6 files)
- **To skip:** audit.log, security.log, cron.log (3 files)
- **Skip due to max rotations:** mail.log (1 file)

**Space to free estimation:** Only files rotated (excluding the one with max reached) — sum their sizes.

Space to free = 245.3 + 512.7 + 78.2 + 1024.0 + 92.0 + 203.6 = 2155.8 MB

Now I'll generate the JSON and bash script.
